info.name: Tile Quest API
info.description: M1 accounts + M2 question bank collection for Tile Quest API

exec: pm.test('Body has token', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(json.token_type).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(json.expires_in).to.be.a('number'); });
const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', json.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminUserId', json.user.user_id);
const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('playerToken', json.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('playerUserId', json.user.user_id); pm.expect(json.user.role).to.eql('player');

pm.test('Error code is INVALID_CREDENTIALS', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.error.code).to.eql('INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); pm.expect(json.error.message).to.eql('Wrong school ID or password.'); });

pm.test('Same error body as wrong password', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.error.code).to.eql('INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); pm.expect(json.error.message).to.eql('Wrong school ID or password.'); });
pm.test('Role is PLAYER', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.user.role).to.eql('PLAYER'); pm.expect(json.user.password_hash).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('No password hash in response', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.user).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
